course.title: Applied Statistics and Queuing Theory
course.department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

content.value: A small departmental store has two light bulbs. On average, a light bulb lasts for 22 (12) [CO1] days (exponentially distributed). When a light bulb burns out, it takes an average of 2 days (exponentially distributed) to be replaced.
(i) Formulate a birth-death model of this situation.
(ii) Determine the fraction of the timé that both light bulbs are working.
(iii)Determine the fraction of the time that no light bulbs are working.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2022
